verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a research-notebook SaaS, so the axis applies, but the evidence documents no bulk actions such as multi-select delete, batch convert, batch export, or bulk import. Choosing which sources to use in chat (picked individually) is only an adjacent scoping control, and converting a note is documented for a single note only. One community user's external scripts to batch-import emails are a user-side workaround and earn no credit.
